name: National Archives and Library of Ethiopia
description: Historical manuscripts and documents library; photography may incur extra fee.

name: Addis Ababa Zoo (Lion Zoo)
description: Home of Abyssinian lions and other animals; pricing often differs for locals and foreigners.

name: Derba Falls
description: Waterfall near Sululta; guide often required and negotiable.

name: Jan Meda
description: Public field used for major festivals like Timkat.

name: Yared School of Music
description: Music institution; access depends on events or concerts.

name: Lake Hawassa Waterfront
description: Scenic lakefront with hippos and birds; boat trips extra.

name: Fish Market (Amora Gedel)
description: No entry fee; pay for fresh fish meals (small park/hyena feeding nearby may have ~50 ETB fee).

name: Tabor Mountain
description: Viewpoint hill with occasional small local fee.

name: St. Gabriel Church
description: Major Ethiopian Orthodox church; donations optional.

name: Hawassa Industrial Park
description: Access limited; entry only with prior permission.

name: Lewi Resort Park
description: Entry often free; pay for activities

name: Tikur Wuha Park
description: Forest park with monkeys and biodiversity.

name: Gudumale Recreation Center
description: Cultural ground for Sidama events and celebrations.

name: Wassa Hotel Viewpoint
description: Popular sunset viewpoint over the lake.

name: Haile Resort Grounds
description: Luxury resort; pay for access to grounds

name: Adare Cultural Village
description: Traditional Sidama cultural experience with guide.

name: Sidama Cultural Hall
description: Venue for events and cultural performances.

name: Loka Abaya National Park
description: Wildlife park; guide and transport usually required.

name: Lake Tana
description: Lake access free; boat tours to monasteries cost 500–1500+ ETB depending on group size.

name: Ura Kidane Mehret
description: Famous island monastery with beautiful murals.

name: Martyrs Memorial Monument
description: Memorial and small regional history exhibit.

name: Lake Tana Marine Transport
description: Boat trips to monasteries and islands.

name: Debre Maryam Monastery
description: Small monastery near Blue Nile outlet.

name: Kibran Gebriel
description: Monastery (access restricted to men only in some areas).

name: Zegie Peninsula
description: Forest peninsula with monasteries and coffee farms.

name: Nech Sar National Park
description: National park with wildlife; guide and vehicle usually required (fees low but extras add up).

name: Crocodile Market
description: Viewing point for crocodiles; tips optional.

name: Lake Chamo
description: Boat tours for crocodiles and hippos (costs vary by boat size).

name: Dorze Village
description: Traditional Dorze cultural village tours with local guides.

name: Lake Abaya
description: Large Rift Valley lake with scenic views.

name: Paradise Lodge Walkway
description: Scenic cliff walkway at the lodge.

name: Shecha District
description: Upper town district with local atmosphere.

name: Nairobi National Park
description: Wildlife park inside the capital; non-resident adult fees recently ~USD 45–80+ (or higher in high season; check KWS for latest).

name: Giraffe Centre
description: Conservation center where you can feed Rothschild giraffes.

name: Karen Blixen Museum
description: Historic home of the Out of Africa author.

name: KICC Rooftop
description: Kenya International Conference Centre rooftop with 360° views.

name: Oloolua Nature Trail
description: Forest trail with waterfall and caves.

name: Snake Park
description: Reptile exhibit next to the museum.

name: Fort Jesus
description: UNESCO Portuguese fort and museum; non-resident adult ~KES 1200 or USD 15 (varies by category).

name: Mombasa Marine National Park
description: Marine reserve for snorkeling; boat costs extra.
